notes.title: Pushing release date to add more content!!
notes.notes:
Hey there players, SerialSC here with an development update for everyone!

The original plan was to release by the end of 2022 - BUT! the content is not quite where I want it to be just yet.

Instead, I am pushing for a launch date at the end of Q1 2023.

Here's some great news though! The goal is to participate in the February version of Steam Next Fest. This means that a FREE DEMO would be available to try out at that time! 

Here's what is on the roadmap for release in Q1 2023:

* AT LEAST 4 Unique levels which use random generation to keep it fresh! Every run is similar but not quire the same
* Online Leaderboards! This is BY FAR the most requested feature! I want to make sure there is ample time to get these up and running nice and smoothly so we can all compete against each other
* Additional "enemy" types! I have added a few new ones into the game already...so if you've already played the previous alpha builds, expect A TON more content.
* New post processing effects and volumetric fog...because even a 1 man show can implement the cool stuff

That's it for now, be on the lookout for more updates soon!
